summary: Iteration 16: tested RO legal holidays + working-day ATR check_due, platform extra days, /atr/deadlines + dashboard panel, aviz upload (API+UI), SLD legacy (from_legacy, PDF text, import-legacy) and 3-inverter SLD. Backend 13/14 pytest pass (1 failure = real SLD label truncation bug). Frontend: all requested flows pass after fixing a JSX build error (missing ) in AtrTracking.jsx that broke the entire app. Found: dashboard deadline row link (?edit=id) does not open the ATR editor.

minor.issue: Aggregated legacy PV label is silently truncated by width-fit: page shows 'Câmp PV total (stringuri nedefinite): 26×' — the panel W and kWp ('475 W = 12.35 kWp') are cut off. Shorten label (e.g. 2 lines: 'Câmp PV total (nedefinit)' + '26×475 W = 12.35 kWp') or widen w. Test: test_aggregate_label_not_truncated.
Legacy strings without panel_voc/isc print 'Voc(-10°C) 0 V · Isc 0 A' — invented zero values; should print [lipsă] like other missing fields.

2026: A doua zi de Rusalii (Easter+50) = 1 June -> dict key collision; 'Ziua Copilului' label lost (16 unique dates, shown only as 'A doua zi de Rusalii'). Workday math correct; cosmetic: join labels on collision.

ui_bugs.issue: BUILD ERROR: missing closing after atr-incomplete-btn row -> Vite 'Unexpected token (91:2)', whole app blank. FIXED by testing agent.
Rows link to /cerere-atr?edit={id} but ModulePage never reads the 'edit' query param (no useSearchParams), so clicking a deadline row only opens the list; the ATR editor/tracking box does not open.

issues: Native browser date pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) used for holiday-date, atr-track-* dates instead of shadcn calendar; locale differs from ro-RO display (dd.mm.yyyy)

action_items: MEDIUM: handle ?edit={id} in ModulePage (open record on load) so dashboard ATR deadline rows open the dossier
MEDIUM: fix truncated aggregated PV label in SLD (panel W / kWp lost) — key data for legacy diagrams
LOW: print [lipsă] instead of 0 V / 0 A for Voc/Isc when panel electrical data missing
LOW: merge holiday labels when two holidays fall on same date (1 June 2026)
critical_code_review_comments: update_item (PUT /data/atr) does not pop aviz_file/atr_ref — a form loaded before a new aviz upload could restore stale values on Save (verified OK in the normal flow: Save after upload kept aviz_file and atr_ref).
from_legacy: inverter_kw is treated as per-inverter (count 2 x 12 kW -> title '24 kW'); confirm classic field semantics (total vs per unit).
calendar extra days are global (single 'main' doc) — affects all tenants; intended (platform-only) but note for docs.
Multi-inverter (3 inv) PDF renders correctly: -PV1.1..-PV3.2, TDC1-3, -Q1..3.1, -F1..3.1, -W1..3.AC/DC, battery only on INV1, all brand_model names present; visual check OK.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested flows pass; deadline-row deep link broken)

seed_data_creation: All is_test ATR/prosumator records, subscribers (test_i16_*, sub_iter16ui@example.com) deleted; calendar extra restored to []; real dossiers verified unchanged by md5 hash before/after.

Dossier ?edit= deep link not supported yet.
rca of the issue: Blank app: AtrTracking.jsx line ~75 the flex row containing 'Completări solicitate' was not closed before the new atr-aviz-box div; JSX parse error at TermsEditor.
